q.t: Alhaitham, why did the book join the police? To go undercover.
q.rt: I'm putting my headphones back on.

q.t: Geo shields are like good contracts: strong, reliable, and difficult to break.
Why do vines make bad workers? They're always hanging around.
The water of Fontaine has a delicate flavor. Today: notes of mountain spring.
What did the Hydro Mimic say? 'I'm just going with the flow.'
Hire a mercenary: protection guaranteed, sarcasm included.
What's a Sand Grease Pupa's motto? Slow and steady wins the wax.
If you call my name, I will come. Please don't call it for trivial things.
What do you call a deer with no eyes? No idea.
Please don't bother me. I'm in the middle of a very important game.
Why do bees have sticky hair? They use honeycombs.
Expedition rewards are like mail. Check daily, sometimes there's a present.
What did the Golden Wolflord say after losing? 'Well, that was ruff.'
Pillars of stone have stood for millennia. My patience with tea that's brewed too long has not.
Why don't Slimes ever win arguments? They always end up a little unstable.
Why is the map full of question marks? Because Paimon hasn't explored there yet!
Why was the Geo Slime so calm? It had rock-solid composure.
Aaru Village welcomes all travelers. Leave your Fatui badge at the gate.
Ayaka, why did the snowflake win the beauty contest? It was one of a kind.
A contract is a promise. A promise is a contract. Mora, however, is a separate matter.
Klee, why do bombs make bad comedians? Their jokes blow up in their face.
q.rt: Klee thinks your jokes go BOOM!

q.t: I recall a time when Liyue had no harbor. Then again, I recall a great many things.
Why don't Treasure Hoarders trust stairs? They're always up to something.
I've climbed every mountain in Teyvat. My stamina bar is still not impressed.
What's the strongest element? Hard to say. But Puns is close.
Courage is a fire you share. Pass it on.
What do you call a Fungus that tells jokes? A fun-gi.
Mora is a tool. Like an Elemental Skill, but shinier.
What do you call a puzzle in the desert that nobody can solve? A typical Tuesday.
If you seek the finest tea, travel to Liyue. If you seek a wallet, bring your own.
Resin regenerates. My patience for bad artifact rolls does not.
Practice makes progress! Even if it's one mob at a time.
Why do Pyro Abyss Mages hate winter? Everything puts out their fire.
Spina di Rosula is open for business! And for macarons.
What do you call a Sumeru scholar who never leaves the library? Well-read and well-hidden.
Forging is easy. Getting the beat right is the hard part.
What do you call a Primordial Sea of Fontaine with no waves? Calm water. Neuvillette approved.
Baron Bunny is ready for action! And for being blown up. Again.
Why do Wenut sandworms never get speeding tickets? They always go underground.
I'm part qilin. That means I enjoy grass salads and working too much.
Why do Geo Slimes make good friends? They're always there for you. They don't move much.
New light novel release! I'm told it's a masterpiece. I wrote the review.
I told Collei a joke and she laughed!
q.rt: She was being polite. I raised her well.

q.t: Hehe, Paimon set a new record for longest nap during a domain run!
Why did the Cryo Regisvine never get invited out? Too cold-hearted.
If a character says 'I have a bad feeling about this,' Paimon is already hiding.
What's a Lumberpick's favorite hobby? Chopping it up with friends.
Fun fact: mushrooms are closer to animals than plants. Please don't tell Cyno.
What do you call a sleepy Sumeru desert? A dune-nap.
Some say I'm old-fashioned. I prefer 'established.'
How do Sumeru scholars stay cool? They sit next to their fans. Mostly Kaveh.
Is there anything I can help with? Cleaning, cooking, defeating a Lawachurl?
What did the 3-star weapon say to the 5-star? 'You're welcome for carrying you to level 20.'
Studying is lovely. Napping in the library is lovelier.
I told a joke at the Grand Bazaar. Nilou gave it a standing ovation. Out of pity.
Efficiency is everything. That's why I teleport to waypoints instead of walking.
Mushrooms are the life of every party. Because they're such fun-guys.
q.rt: I've heard this one six times.

q.t: Pers says the sea is calm today. Pers is usually right.
Why did the Ruin Grader go to therapy? It had too many issues to grade.
Hey! Paimon found a Precious Chest! ...Okay, it was a Common Chest. Still counts!
I'm reading a book about anti-gravity in Sumeru. I can't put it down.
Good news! I found a chest. Bad news: it was a Ruin Guard.
Why did the Fungi start a band? They had great spore-ts.
A maid's duty never ends. Neither does dusting the Knights' Headquarters.
I'm reading a book about Sumeru forests. It's leaf-ing me speechless.
Every scent tells a story. Most stories in Fontaine end with a perfume.
Xiao, why did the almond tofu cross the road? To get to the adeptus.
Paimon's top tip: level your weapon before complaining about damage!
I don't need luck. I have a 4-star weapon and a dream.
Ghosts love me. It's the hat.
Why do Sumeru jungle trees make bad liars? You can always see through the canopy.
Qiqi! Stop following me! ...Oh wait, you're just here for the coconut milk.
Venti, why don't bards ever get cold? They always have a warm-up song.
q.rt: Ehe! I'll write a ballad about that.

q.t: Today's mission: open one more chest than yesterday.
What did the Pyro Slime say to the Cryo Slime? 'Let's melt the ice between us.'
Paimon has a great idea: what if we spend all our Primogems right now?
q.rt: That's how we got here, Paimon.

q.t: My favorite exercise? Running away from Tighnari after a pun.
Plan your Resin. Plan your routes. Plan your naps.
Faruzan, why are ancient puzzles like your jokes? Nobody understands them for a century.
q.rt: Young man, I'll have you know I'm a treasure.

q.t: My siblings asked what I do for work. I said 'international relations.'
What's Mondstadt's favorite letter? The Anemo-gram.
Thank you for visiting today. May your next Wish be golden.
Tighnari, your ears are perfect for listening to my jokes.
q.rt: They're perfect for hearing you coming.

q.t: Cold weather doesn't bother me. Neither does silence.
I don't always crit. But when I do, the enemy files a complaint.
Do not skip your Hydro resonance. It's simply refreshing.
What did the Sumeru Rose say after a long day? 'I'm feeling a little wilted.'
Paimon's advice for the day: be kind, explore lots, and share your snacks.
What's a Fontaine lawyer's favorite drink? Justice juice. Freshly squeezed.
I'm in energy-saving mode. Please speak quietly.
I lost my Genius Invokation deck once. I had to deal with it.
If you find a chest and don't open it, Paimon will be very disappointed.
Why do Sumeru bees make great students? They always buzz through exams.
Sail the seas, fight the storms, and always tip your crew.
Candace, why did the shield go to school? To get a little more defensive training.
Poetry and swordplay: both are about knowing when to stop.
What's a sandstorm's favorite game? Hide and sneeze.
Experiment 47: can a Slime be domesticated? Results: no. It ate the notes.
Kirara, why don't boxes ever get lonely? They're always surrounded by packages.
q.rt: Hehe, that's my kind of joke!

q.t: A wild Oculus appeared! Paimon's job is to point. Your job is to climb.
What's the Traveler's favorite type of math? Teleport-ation tables.
I'm a little scared of heights. But I'm a lot brave about rocks!
What's the best way to watch a Sumeru sunset? With sand-glasses.
Why do bards make great Anemo users? We're full of hot air and good vibes.
I wrote you a pun, Tighnari. It's a little corny.
The Dawn Winery produces fine wine. I simply don't have to drink it.
Why did the treasure chest refuse to open? It had trust issues. And a puzzle.
Losing a 50/50? Think of it as a chance to try a new friend.
What do you call a forest ranger who studies weather? A mist-ologist.
q.rt: I'm adding that to the list of things you've made up.

q.t: Collei, remember to drink water on patrol. Even Dendro characters wilt.
Hard pity is like the desert. It always arrives eventually.
Don't forget the Elemental Mastery stat. And sleep. Mostly sleep.
Kaveh, why did the architect break up with the draft? It wasn't on the same page.
Klee asked me to make a bomb that's 'more boom.' I declined. Mostly.
Neuvillette, why does water make good court testimony? It's always clear.
Qiqi wrote a note. Qiqi forgot what the note was for.
What did the Sumeru Rose say to the bee? 'Buzz off, I'm a protected species.'
Celebrate every win! Even the small ones. Especially the small ones.
What's Inazuma's favorite dance? The Electro slide.
Every case has a clue. Most of them are snacks left at the scene.
Kaveh, why don't architects ever win at cards? They keep building houses.
q.rt: At least my houses stand up. Unlike your puns.

q.t: What's the scariest thing in Teyvat? An empty Resin bar.
Remember to redeem your codes. Every Primogem counts.
Arataki Itto, Number One Oni! Beetle wrestling champion of the world!
q.rt: Boss, we talked about the beetles.

q.t: Consistency is key. That's why I tell a pun every day.
Tea is best enjoyed slowly. Much like a six-thousand-year retirement.
Why did the Kairagi bring a sword to dinner? He wanted a sharp conversation.
Fireworks are my love language! Also hugs. Fireworks first.
Why did the Ley Line Outcrop feel used? Everyone only came for the Mora.
Dance like the Zubayr Theater is watching. Because it is!
Unlucky? Me? I just make adventures more exciting!
Every journey begins with a single step. Or a single waypoint.
Life's short! Make sure you've maxed your talents first.
Daily reminder: your Resin is full. The domain misses you.
Hard fights are just beetle battles with bigger beetles!
Why do Fontaine fish love court? They enjoy a good trial by water.
A secret temple, a hidden path, and a mystery. It's like a normal Tuesday.
Tighnari, do you have a minute? I have three new puns.
q.rt: I have a minute. I don't have three puns' worth.

q.t: Logic is a tool. So are headphones. Both help me avoid conversations.
I'm starting a forest comedy club. It'll be a real tree-t.
q.rt: I'll be busy that day. Every day.

q.t: Your healer is your best friend. Your Bennett is your best everything.
Why did the Abyss Mage cross the road? To get to the other shield.
The best team? The one you have fun playing. Ehe!
Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
q.rt: That's not even a Sumeru joke.

q.t: Running a clan is easy. Running a clan without anyone noticing is the real skill.
Alhaitham, I have a joke about the Akademiya.
Eternity is unchanging. Except for the menu, apparently.
q.rt: Please, Ei, step away from the kitchen.

q.t: Spiral Abyss 36 stars? That's me on a good day. And a lot of retries.
My Elemental Burst is like a good pun. Takes a while to charge, worth the wait.
Klee has been grounded. Again. Please report any unexpected explosions.
What did the Seelie say to the Traveler? 'Follow me, I know a shortcut.' It did not.
I can use seven elements, but I still can't escape the daily Commissions.
How do forest animals stay in touch? They use the Tree-hugger network.
Ehe! The wind told me a secret: today's a good day for a song.
Tighnari, what do you call a Sumeru Rose that sings? A flower power ballad.
q.rt: I'm going back to my patrol.

q.t: Fill your Serenitea Pot with friends. And cushions. Lots of cushions.
I'm a Cryo exorcist with a yang body. Please don't offer me spicy food.
What's a ranger's favorite type of tea? Forest-ry.
Every time you skip dialogue, Paimon loses a little sparkle.
Wriothesley, why is tea a good prisoner? It always gets steeped in time.
q.rt: I'll pour you a cup for that one.

q.t: Every region has a giant tree, a giant problem, and Paimon asking for food.
Traveler, what do you call a twin who wanders? A sibling-seeker. Sorry. That got real.
Champion Duelist rule: politeness first, Electro second.
When in doubt, check your Elemental Mastery. When still in doubt, check again.
Paimon thinks the best artifact substat is the one we don't have.
Why did the Electro Hypostasis refuse to fight? It wasn't in the right cube of mind.
Stay hydrated, take your medicine, and please don't fight Lawachurls without a healer!
Furina, why did the actor fall off the stage? She was just going through a dramatic phase.
q.rt: How DARE you! ...That was actually good.

q.t: Spent all my Fragile Resin. Got one decent goblet. Worth it.
I wanted to be a comedian, but my jokes kept getting judged. Then I remembered I'm the judge.
The best place to nap in Mondstadt? Windrise. Ask anyone. Ask me.
I told a joke to a Ruin Guard. It didn't laugh, but it did get a little rusty.
Today's special: Slime Jelly Surprise! The surprise is it's edible.
q.rt: Paimon will try it! ...Paimon regrets nothing.

q.t: The secret to a perfect team? Synergy. And snacks. Mostly snacks.
Welcome to the Fortress of Meropide. Tea is complimentary. Leaving is not.
Collei says my jokes are getting better.
My adventuring rule: if a chest looks suspicious, it's guarded by a Ruin Guard.
Why did the Hilichurl bring a ladder to the Abyss? He heard Floor 12 was the next level.
Use your Elemental Burst. It's not doing anything sitting there.
Why did the Fatui Cicin Mage bring a jar? To keep her bug-dget in check.
I solved three star charts last night. I don't remember any of it.
My Energy Recharge is 100%. My energy to recharge after work is 0%.
Paimon says: always check behind the waterfall. There's usually a chest. Usually.
I've prepared a joke about Pyro. It's lit.
Every Anemo character is a support character in their heart.
The desert taught me patience. Gacha taught me humility.
Paimon can float, but Paimon still can't reach that last Anemoculus.
What do you call a Hydro Slime with a cold? A little drippy.
Mortals call it Electro. I call it 'my divine judgment.'
When your team wipes, take a breath. Then blame the Abyss Mage.
Cooking boosts are free damage. Don't skip them!
Why don't Ruin Hunters tell secrets? Too many moving parts.
Healing everyone is my job! And singing. Mostly singing!
Thoma, why did the housekeeper bring a broom to the party? To sweep everyone off their feet.
q.rt: Ha! I'll tell the young lady.

q.t: Klee's new rule: fish blasting only on days ending in 'day'!
Why did the Anemo Slime start a podcast? It had a lot of hot air.
Rock and roll is my religion. Pyro is my amplifier.
Nahida, what do you call a sleepy Archon? A Dendro-zzz.
q.rt: Hehe. I'll keep that one in the Irminsul.

q.t: If you see a glowing mushroom in the forest, do not eat it. Do not let Paimon eat it either.
What do you call a lazy kangaroo? A pouch potato.
q.rt: There are no kangaroos in Sumeru.

q.t: A martial artist reads books. A smart martial artist reads Bennett's luck ahead of time.
Why did the Fatui Agent get lost? He couldn't find his way out of the shadows.
Sumeru rainforest tip: if it's raining, it's normal. If it's not raining, wait five minutes.
Lisa, why are library books so tired? They've been checked out all day.
For my next trick, I'll make your Primogems disappear. Oh, you already did that?
Tighnari, I've been practicing new puns all night!
Express delivery! Please sign here. Also, can I sleep in this box?
I wrote a joke about the Spiral Abyss timer. It ran out before the punchline.
Don't forget to check the map for Dendroculi. They hide in plain sight. Like me.
Collei, why don't archers ever get lost? They always know their aim.
Every rock has a story. Most of them are about other rocks.
Zhongli, why don't Geo users ever lose their keys? They keep everything set in stone.
The library is quiet. That's why I'm here. Kaveh isn't.
Why don't Hilichurls go to school? They already know 'Mi muhe ye.'
Lupical say: always hunt with friends. Friends share meat.
What's a mushroom's favorite place to vacation? The Mush-room-dstadt.
q.rt: That's a stretch, even for you.

q.t: Fashion tip: dress for the boss fight you want.
Why don't Pyro Specter jokes work? They're too much hot air.
A secret? Of course I have one. Several, actually. Good luck.
I tried to start a Sumeru bakery. Business was un-bread-ictable.
Almond tofu tastes like a beautiful dream. Do not tell anyone I said that.
What do you call a group of Hilichurls singing? A Hili-choir.
The stars say you'll pull a 5-star soon. The stars also say I'm broke.
I found a four-leaf Sumeru Rose. My Wish luck did not improve.
I have discovered a new art: sweets. They are a form of eternity.
Wanderer, why did the hat go to the party? To make a big impression.
Sweet Madame is the best food in Teyvat. Paimon has done extensive research.
My Crit Rate is like my jokes. Low, but when it lands, it really lands.
The Opera Epiclese presents: me! In a dramatic monologue about cake.
Albedo, why did the alchemist get kicked out of class? He kept experimenting with the rules.
Oz, record this: the Prinzessin has defeated another Slime!
q.rt: Recorded, my lady. It was a small one.

q.t: I'd tell you a joke about the Sumeru Akademiya, but you'd need six years of study to get it.
I'm not saying I'm an Archon, but the wind does follow me around a lot.
Why are deserts so good at keeping secrets? Everything stays under the sand.
Hu Tao asked me to promote the funeral parlor. I declined. Gracefully.
q.rt: He'll come around! Everyone does eventually!

q.t: Why do Hilichurls love music? They've got a lot of 'Ya!' in them.
Yuegui is ready to help! It's very good at carrying radishes.
I tried to make a Pyro pun, but it didn't catch fire.
If you see Kaeya at Angel's Share, please remind him he has a tab.
I'm on a seafood diet. I see a Fontaine fish, and I leave it alone. Neuvillette is watching.
Don't forget your weekly bosses. They miss you terribly.
Today's forecast: 100% chance of puns, with scattered groans.
Statistically, the next artifact will also be bad. Farm anyway.
My Crit Ratio is 1:2. My Pun Ratio is 1:1. Perfectly balanced.
Beauty is in the details. Unfortunately, so is the budget.
My Constellation level? Zero. My joke level? Six.
Dandelion wine is just apple cider with ambition. Don't tell Diluc I said that.
Why do plants hate math? It gives them square roots.
q.rt: I teach the forest kids that one now. Thanks, I guess.

q.t: Outrider tip: always carry a glider. Gravity doesn't take days off.
Why don't Ruin Sentinels ever relax? They're always on guard.
Reminder: claim your daily Primogems. Drama requires a budget.
A wise man once said: build Crit first, ask questions later.
Paimon's guide to Wishing: close your eyes, hope, and don't look at the pity counter.
Why is the Spiral Abyss so bad at parties? It keeps resetting every two weeks.
Breaking news: the Traveler opened another chest! More at eleven.
My favorite Sumeru dish is Biryani. My favorite Sumeru pun is everything I say.
I do not enjoy the rain because I am sad. I simply enjoy the rain.
Why don't Sumeru scholars play hide and seek? Good luck hiding from the Akasha.
Church work is fine. Night shifts are better.
Why did the mushroom go to the forest party? Because he was a fungi.
q.rt: That's two mushroom puns this week. I'm counting.

q.t: Traveler! There's a Seelie over there! Wait, no, that's a Crystalfly. Get it!
Why don't Slimes play poker? They can't keep a straight face. Or a face.
Books are due in two weeks, darling. Lightning arrives sooner.
What do you call an artifact with perfect substats? A myth. A legend. A screenshot.
Paimon's favorite element? The element of surprise! And snacks!
Primogems are like sand in the desert. Everywhere, until you need them.
Teleport waypoints are the true heroes of Teyvat.
Dehya, why do mercenaries make good comedians? Great punch lines.
Cryo and charm. The two things I never run out of.
Baizhu, why did the snake go to the doctor? It felt a little scale-y.
Theoretically, every artifact has potential. Practically, most are fodder.
Rule of the desert: never trust a sand dune. They shift their story.
Astrology is a precise science. Mora management, less so.
Why are forest rangers so calm? They've got roots.
q.rt: We're calm because you're usually in the desert.

q.t: Try charged shots. Then try another. Then another. It's soothing.
Why do Abyss Heralds wear masks? Bad hair days.
Klee counted all the bombs. There's one missing. Don't worry about it!
An Archon never cries. She simply has a very emotional performance.
Paimon would like to remind everyone that Paimon is NOT emergency food. Today, or any day.
I practiced archery all morning! I only hit one tree. On purpose.
Back in my day, puzzles had puzzles inside them.
I tried to tell a joke about the Abyss. It was too deep.
I love a good fight! Do you think the Abyss would let me in early?
What's a General Mahamatra's favorite game? Genius Invokation. Obviously. Want to play?
A good drink can cure anything! ...Except my love for not serving alcohol.
The best puns are like rare chests. You have to search to appreciate them.
Spiral Abyss tip: rest well before Floor 12. It's a long climb.
My hobbies include judging, Genius Invokation, and judging Genius Invokation.
Peace is a job. Aerial patrol is a job. Coffee is also a job.
Overtime is my specialty. Sleep is my dream.
Contracts are simple: you pay, I hunt. Ajaw complains.
Every new region is a new adventure. And a new map full of question marks.
Layla, why did the star go to sleep? It was a little burnt out.
q.rt: Please don't remind me about sleep.

q.t: Reminder: Paperwork is also a form of adventuring. A very slow one.
Cuilein-Anbar says hello! He's a puppet, but he's polite.
For the record: I will remember every pun you make. For revenge.
Guoba helped me cook dinner! Then Guoba ate dinner.
I designed a house for Alhaitham. He didn't say thank you. Typical.
I lost my hat once. The entire region heard about it.
Why did the Crystalfly break up with the Lantern? It wasn't a bright idea.
The children of the House of the Hearth do their homework. Every night. No exceptions.
What did the tree say to the wind? 'Leaf me alone.'
Paimon read the patch notes. Paimon understood about half. The tasty half.
Tighnari, are you a botanist? Because you've got a lot of plant-ential.
Dodoco says hi! Dodoco also says Klee should get a bigger bomb.
Paimon, why don't emergency foods panic? They're always on the menu.
Patience in Wishing is a virtue. So is not spending one's rent on it.
An experiment that goes wrong is still an experiment. Just a louder one.
Itto, why do beetles make great fighters? They're bug-tastic.
q.rt: HAHA! I knew you'd get it, Cyno!

q.t: Fishing is relaxing. Fighting is relaxing. Fishing for a fight? Even better.
Information is my trade. Your secrets are safe. Probably.
Wangsheng Funeral Parlor: buy one, get one... Hmm, maybe I need a better slogan.
Why do Seelies never get lost? They always follow their light.
If you need something, just ask! I'm a housekeeper, but I'm also handy.
Two Hydro, one Electro, and a Dendro. That's not a recipe, that's a reaction.
Fried tofu is the true divine offering. The Shrine accepts donations.
Why was the cactus such a good judge? It always got to the point.
Paimon has a nickname for every character. Most of them are about food.
Why did the Geovishap bring earplugs to the party? It heard there'd be a lot of hard rock.
Surf's up! The Natlan waves are calling, and I'm answering!
Why do Electro characters make great friends? They really spark joy.
Dreams are like seeds. Water them, and they grow.
Why did the mushroom get invited to every party? He was a fungi to be with.
A good strategy wins battles. A great strategy wins naps.
Why did the Oceanid quit acting? Too many roles in one bubble.
Ninja tip: the best stealth move is a good nap.
Navia, I heard macarons have a pun-ishing price.
q.rt: Want to share some? I always bring extra.

q.t: Rest, drink tea, and don't fight Lawachurls on an empty stomach. Doctor's orders.
I trained in the desert for years. Still can't dodge a 50/50.
Reading the weekly event notes counts as studying. I've decided.
Why did the Sumeru Akademiya hire a pirate? For the Arrrr-chives.
I challenge you to a beetle battle! Loser buys onigiri!
Nilou, why did the dancer bring a ladder? To reach new heights in the Zubayr Theater.
They say I'm a hero of many nations. Mostly I just carry Paimon's snacks.
Why did the domain close on Mondays? Even artifacts need a weekend.
Did you know Sumeru Roses smell sweetest after the rain? Little facts make big days.
Why did the Lawachurl skip leg day? Too much stomping already.
Being a puppet with a grudge is a full-time job. Do not interrupt.
What's a forest ranger's favorite subject? Tree-gonometry.
Stamina is a resource. So is a really comfy box.
An artifact with four Defense substats walks into a bar. Nobody wanted it there.
Rules exist for a reason. That reason is usually Lyney.
I asked the Akasha for a joke. It said my request was 'below the academic threshold.' Rude.
Life's a lot like a macaron: fragile, sweet, and better when shared.
Why don't trees play cards? Too many leaves.
q.rt: You've been waiting all day to say that.

q.t: The leaves tell me a storm is coming. Or a domain run. Hard to tell.
A good build is like a good joke. It's all about the timing. And the Crit Damage.
Zhongli, it's your turn to pay.
q.rt: I believe I have forgotten my wallet. Again.

q.t: What's a Ruin Drake's favorite music? Heavy metal.
Tea ceremony and swordsmanship share one secret: patience.
What do you call a cat in Sumeru? A purr-mit holder.
Any domain worth doing is worth doing twice. Or ten times. For artifacts.
Why don't Sumeru foxes ever lose? They're too foxy.
Diluc, can I get a drink?
Why did the Treasure Hoarder go to school? To improve his loot-eracy.
Qiqi likes coconut milk. Qiqi does not like Hu Tao chasing Qiqi.
Why did the Thunder Manifestation get grounded? It was acting out of line.
I've read every book in Sumeru. My favorite? The one about the Traveler.
Why did the Electro Slime get a job? It needed to charge for its services.
Daily Commissions done? Paimon wants to celebrate with a feast!
Why did the Bountiful Core feel important? Everyone was bloom-ing around it.
Legal tip: read the contract. Zhongli wrote half of them.
Why don't Eremites ever get lost? They always find their sand-wich.
Fireflies glow brighter when you aren't looking. Just like Ororon.
My weapon? Staff of the Scarlet Sands. My mood? Staff of the Scarlet Puns.
Pro tip: glide first, ask questions later.
What do Scarabs do on weekends? Bug out.
What do you call a Mitachurl who tells jokes? A Mita-churl-ckle.
When life gives you sand, build a sandcastle. When it gives you resin, farm artifacts.
Diluc, why did the grape break up with the raisin? It needed space to grow.
